dimensions.name: Leadership and sponsorship
dimensions.evidence_question: Who has accepted the charter, residual risk and stop/go decision rights?

dimensions.name: Skills and training
dimensions.evidence_question: What source/error/escalation practice demonstrates competence, including ordinary staff and backup?

dimensions.name: Workflow and process
dimensions.evidence_question: How do review, exceptions, publication control and manual fallback work in a rehearsal?

dimensions.name: Infrastructure and data
dimensions.evidence_question: What exact model/data/tools/route and logs are permitted and source-linked?

dimensions.name: Resources and budget
dimensions.evidence_question: What funded protected hours cover setup, checking, correction, support, peaks and absence for this stage?

dimensions.name: Governance and risk
dimensions.evidence_question: Who can stop, escalate, restore and authorize a changed scope?

dimensions.name: Culture and change
dimensions.evidence_question: What actual consultation, workload feedback or concerns have affected users supplied?

dimensions.name: Operating ownership
dimensions.evidence_question: Who has accepted service duty, cover, incidents, maintenance, change and retirement?

rule: Assess the named stage. Known critical gap blocks that stage; critical unknown withholds an affirmative finding and requests evidence. No averaging. Partial findings must identify the supported part and the unresolved critical part. Unknown does not prove absence.

stages.planning: Non-executing evidence collection may continue without tool/data execution permission.
stages.isolated_learning: Scope-specific permission, accepted lead/cover, competent protected review, allowed data/route and stop/fallback plus bounded resources must be supported.
stages.routine_operation: Requires ongoing scope authority, task/value qualification and release by humans plus sustainable ownership, recurring capacity/resources, monitoring/change/incident controls and user feedback.

unknown_triage: ASK_NOW: factual decision-critical evidence needed before the dependent step.
CLOSE_BY_DECISION: a qualified authority can appoint/fund/authorize; a proposed decision is not completion.
OBSERVE_IN_AUTHORIZED_LEARNING: acceptance, handling times and workflow effectiveness can be measured within a genuinely permitted scope.
boundary: State technology/application evidence separately. A simpler-task concern is sent back to Adoption; this expert does not certify strategic fit or redefine technology maturity.
